pretreatment: annealed at 1000 ◦C for 2 h in a nitrogen atmosphere
surface_functionalization: Al2O3 surface passivation layer deposited by ALD
evidence: ZnO thin ﬁlms were deposited on a (0 0 0 2)-oriented sapphire substrate held at 180 ◦C... After deposition, the ﬁlms were annealed using a furnace at 1000 ◦C for 2 h in a nitrogen atmosphere to improve crystal quality. Subsequently, a 10 nm Al 2 O3 ﬁlm was deposited on top of the ZnO ﬁlms by ALD at a substrate temperature of 300 ◦C.
